value.name: asha announces she will hold buyers
value.description: Asha says the loose page names Rosa for the house and that she will write the buyers to hold until she verifies the signature and witnessing.
evidence: in the hall she said, evenly, that the loose page named Rosa for the house and that until she could verify the signature and the witnessing she would be writing the buyers to hold

value.name: daniel challenges asha's trust
value.description: Daniel lowers his hand from his neck and asks whether Asha means to trust Rosa over him.
evidence: Daniel's hand finally came down from his neck; he did not argue, only asked, in a voice gone thin, whether she meant to take Rosa's word over his

value.name: rosa silently confirms codicil
value.description: Rosa remains silent behind Daniel, and the narration confirms that the codicil exists even though its probate value is uncertain.
evidence: Rosa, behind him, did not answer because she did not need to. The codicil existed. What it was worth in probate court was another matter

value.name: asha doubts the page is sufficient
value.description: Asha recognizes that the page she has is not enough by itself to prove the claim in court.
evidence: Asha already knew the page in her hand was not enough on its own

value.name: asha thinks of lucia upstairs
value.description: Asha remembers Lucia staying upstairs in the sewing room all morning and not coming down while the attic was opened.
evidence: She thought of Lucia, upstairs since morning in the sewing room with the door half shut, and of the way Lucia had not come down once while the attic was being opened

value.name: asha heads back upstairs
value.description: Asha leaves the hall and starts back up the stairs toward the sewing room at the same steady pace.
evidence: Asha did not stay in the hall long enough for Daniel to find his footing again. She turned on the half-landing she had just left behind, the blue folder still flat against the bank statements, and started back up the stairs toward the sewing room with the same even pace she had come down with

value.name: lucia emerges with folded paper
value.description: As Asha nears the second-floor landing, Lucia opens the sewing room door and steps out holding a folded sheet of paper against her cardigan.
evidence: She was halfway to the second-floor landing when the sewing room door opened ahead of her, and Lucia stepped out holding a folded sheet of paper against the front of her cardigan, one finger pressed to the crease as if it might lift on its own

value.name: lucia confronts asha with paper
value.description: Lucia comes down to meet Asha and stops above her, holding the paper between them without speaking.
evidence: Lucia came down to meet her without speaking, stopping a step above Asha so that the paper was between them at chest height
